summary: The vector lies in the range of arrowTensor, on which the chosen left inverse is a right inverse.

steps.claim: Since arrowTensor is injective with left inverse leftInverse (leftInverse_arrowTensor), arrowTensor(leftInverse(F)) = F for every F in its range, which is 𝒲_f(Hom(X′, X⁻ ⊕ X″)) (range_arrowTensor); it remains that F = zeroTermFin(ϱ_f(stackedTFin)(Φ ⊠ Ψ)) lies there.

Φ ⊠ Ψ = arrowTensor(Φ ⊗ Ψ) lies in 𝒲_f(Hom(V′, V⁻ ⊕ V″)) (range_arrowTensor), ϱ_f preserves the finite part (finHeisOp_mem_finitePart), and zeroTermFin maps finite parts to finite parts (zeroTermFin_spec (i)).
